howto.what_en: Claude copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs a pinned @chat-adapter/whatsapp, and prompts you to write the four Meta credentials into .env.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add the official WhatsApp Cloud API channel to NanoClaw, or during the /setup flow when this channel is being added.
